# pagetitle sets only the browser tab; the visible title is the H1 below, which
# also renders in the knit_child pkgdown embed.
pagetitle: "IP monitoring: IP Non-Starter & Premature Treatment Discontinuation"
output:
  html_document:
    mathjax: null
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
      smooth_scroll: true
    css: styles.css
params:
  dfResults: NA
  lListings: NA
  dSnapshotDate: NA
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(gsm.kri)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

lListings <- params$lListings
dSnapshotDate <- params$dSnapshotDate
Mapped_SUBJ <- lListings$Mapped_SUBJ

# One classified frame feeds every chart, the overview and the listing.
bHasPTD <- !is.null(Mapped_SUBJ) &&
  "drv_treatment_discontinuation_dt" %in% names(Mapped_SUBJ)
dfIPC <- ipc_ClassifyParticipants(
  dfIPNS = lListings$Mapped_IPNS,
  dfSubj = Mapped_SUBJ,
  dfStudComp = lListings$Mapped_STUDCOMP,
  dSnapshotDate = dSnapshotDate
)
has_participants <- nrow(dfIPC) > 0
dfStats <- ipc_OverviewStats(dfIPC, bHasPTD)
status_rows <- lapply(
  c(study = "study", country = "country", site = "site"),
  function(level) ipc_StatusRows(dfIPC, level)
)
reason_data <- ipc_ReasonRows(dfIPC, bHasPTD)
has_reasons <- has_participants && length(reason_data$order) > 0
# One range for the three scatters.
nMaxDays <- max(c(1, dfIPC$days_since_enrl, dfIPC$days_to_event), na.rm = TRUE)

status_note <- function(level) {
  cat(
    "\n> One bar per ", level, ", as % of its participants: all enrolled, or only dosed or not dosed when the participant filter is set. Use the chart's position control for counts.",
    if (level != "study") paste0(" Click a ", level, " bar to filter."),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
reasons_empty <- if (bHasPTD) {
  "\n> No premature treatment discontinuations recorded.\n"
} else {
  "\n> Premature treatment discontinuation data not available.\n"
}
reasons_note <- function(level) {
  htmltools::tags$p(
    id = paste0("ipc-", level, "-reasons-note"),
    class = "ipc-note",
    style = "display:none;",
    "No premature treatment discontinuations: the Not dosed filter excludes every dosed participant."
  )
}
reasons_text <- "\n> Bars are % of dosed participants in scope; a participant counts once under each of their reasons. A discontinuation without a reason shows as **Not yet recorded**.\n"
tte_text <- "\n> Points on the dashed diagonal have no event yet: potential IP non-starters and **Ongoing** participants. Points above it had their event: study completion (**Study complete**), treatment discontinuation (**Premature treatment discontinuation**) or study completion record (**Confirmed IP non-starter**). Squares are dosed participants, circles are not dosed. Click a legend entry to hide a status in every scatter; double-click to show only that status.\n"
```

```{r subtitle, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
))
```

```{r filter-strip-css, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Inline and literal hex: the pkgdown embed loads neither styles.css nor its
# var(--...) tokens.
cat('
<style>
.ipc-filter-strip { position: sticky; top: 48px; z-index: 1029; display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; background-color: #f1f7fe; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfe3fb; padding: 8px 14px; margin: 0 0 16px; }
.ipc-filter-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5b7193; }
.ipc-dosed { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #3C587F; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; }
.ipc-dosed button { border: none; background-color: #ffffff; color: #3C587F; font-size: 13px; padding: 3px 12px; cursor: pointer; }
.ipc-dosed button + button { border-left: 1px solid #3C587F; }
.ipc-dosed button[aria-pressed="true"] { background-color: #3C587F; color: #ffffff; }
.ipc-dosed button:focus-visible, .ipc-chip button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3C587F; outline-offset: 2px; }
.ipc-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #3C587F; border-radius: 16px; padding: 3px 6px 3px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: #3C587F; }
.ipc-chip-value { font-weight: 600; }
.ipc-chip button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background-color: transparent; color: #3C587F; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
.ipc-chip button:hover { background-color: #3C587F; color: #ffffff; }
.ipc-note { color: #8A5A00; background-color: #FFF6E0; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; }

</style>
')
```

```{r filter-strip, echo=FALSE}
# htmltools, not raw HTML, so pandoc does not wrap the controls in a <p>.
chip <- function(key, label) {
  htmltools::tags$span(
    id = paste0("ipc-chip-", key),
    class = "ipc-chip",
    style = "display:none;",
    htmltools::tags$span(label, ": ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "ipc-chip-value")),
    htmltools::tags$button(
      type = "button",
      `data-ipc-clear` = key,
      `aria-label` = paste("Clear", tolower(label), "filter"),
      htmltools::HTML("&times;")
    )
  )
}
dosed_button <- function(value, label) {
  htmltools::tags$button(
    id = paste0("ipc-dosed-", value),
    type = "button",
    `data-ipc-dosed` = value,
    `aria-pressed` = if (value == "all") "true" else "false",
    label
  )
}
htmltools::tags$div(
  id = "ipc-filter-strip",
  class = "ipc-filter-strip",
  htmltools::tags$span(class = "ipc-filter-eyebrow", "Participants"),
  htmltools::tags$span(
    class = "ipc-dosed",
    role = "group",
    `aria-label` = "Dosed filter",
    dosed_button("all", "All"),
    dosed_button("Y", "Dosed"),
    dosed_button("N", "Not dosed")
  ),
  chip("country", "Country"),
  chip("site", "Site")
)
```

## Study Overview

```{r overview, echo=FALSE}
overview_cell <- function(n, pct, base) {
  if (is.na(n)) {
    return("Premature treatment discontinuation data not available")
  }
  paste0(
    "<div style='font-size:1.1em'>", n, "</div>",
    if (!is.na(pct)) {
      sprintf("<div style='color:#666;font-size:smaller'>%.1f%% of %s</div>", pct, base)
    }
  )
}
knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(
    as.list(stats::setNames(
      unlist(Map(overview_cell, dfStats$n, dfStats$pct, dfStats$base)),
      dfStats$label
    )),
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  format = "html",
  escape = FALSE,
  align = "r",
  table.attr = "class=\"table table-bordered\""
)
```

```{r empty-state, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=!has_participants}
cat("\n> **No enrolled participants.** The charts and the participant listing are empty for this snapshot.\n")
```

## Study {.tabset .tabset-pills}

### Status
```{r study-status, echo=FALSE, eval=has_participants}
gsm.vizr::bars(
  data = status_rows$study[status_rows$study$Dosed == "all", ],
  spec = ipc_StatusBarSpec("study"),
  metadata = list(chartId = "ipc-study-status", level = "study"),
  # One bar needs far less than the 500px default floor.
  height = 230,
  minHeight = 230
)
```

```{r study-status-note, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=has_participants}
status_note("study")
```

### Reasons
```{r study-reasons, echo=FALSE, eval=has_reasons}
htmltools::tagList(
  reasons_note("study"),
  gsm.vizr::bars(
    data = reason_data$study,
    spec = ipc_ReasonBarSpec(reason_data$order),
    metadata = list(chartId = "ipc-study-reasons", level = "study")
  )
)
```

```{r study-reasons-text, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=has_participants}
cat(if (has_reasons) reasons_text else reasons_empty)
```

## Participant listing

```{r listing, echo=FALSE, eval=has_participants}
ipc_Listing(ipc_ListingData(dfIPC, bHasPTD))
```

```{r listing-note, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(
  "\n",
  "> - Only one **Status** is assigned to each participant (enrolled only).\n",
  "> - **IP non-starter statuses** (potential within window, potential outside window, confirmed) = participant not dosed.\n",
  "> - **Premature treatment discontinuation** = dosed participant with a recorded treatment discontinuation date; takes precedence over Study complete.\n",
  "> - **Study complete** = study completion CRF is completed.\n",
  "> - **Ongoing** = no other status criteria met.\n",
  "> - **Consent withdrawn** is a separate flag, not a status: the study completion CRF reports withdrawal of consent (`compreas`).\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

```{r ipc-data, echo=FALSE, eval=has_participants}
ipc_DataScript(list(status = status_rows, reasons = reason_data))
```
